decision.text: D2: SCOPE, measured against Akien's purpose rule. determinism stays in cairn/tools/ because cairn/tools/bus_client uses it, so it has a purpose outside the pipeline. import_sieve and ticket_inspector are tools: CLAUDE.md says a tool's definition berths once in tools/ and a tool has users, not owners (Law 6), so they stay in cairn/tools/ with codemother as a holder. Akien may override.
